summaries.text:
Convenient Care for Caregivers Act

This bill requires the Administration on Aging to make grants to support projects that offer health care services and other support to individuals with Alzheimer’s disease (or a related disorder) and to their family caregivers at the same time and location.

Grants may be made to area agencies on aging, senior centers, institutions of higher education, or tribal organizations. Funds may be used to provide health screenings, caregiver support groups, insurance support, and other services.
